tasks.label: Web (browser)
tasks.detail: Dev server at localhost:8081 — use Chrome DevTools device mode for phone/iPad sizes

tasks.label: Mobile (QR / simulator)
tasks.detail: Scan the QR with Expo Go, or press i for iOS Simulator / a for Android

tasks.label: Desktop (macOS)

tasks.label: Typecheck all
tasks.command: npm run build --workspace @synapse/core && npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json
